title: Element-Guided Span Elicitation Output
description: Step 423C. Output of one element-guided elicitation call: a list of quotes per neutral, ordinal search target ("Target N"). Contains NO provision/LP ids, NO coverage verdicts, NO risk or favorability labels, and NO legal conclusions — additionalProperties: false at both levels is the structural enforcement mechanism, matching 423B's contract. The mapping from "Target N" back to an element_id happens in code (lease_element_elicitation.py), never in the model's output.

target.description: The neutral, ordinal target label as given in the prompt (e.g. "Target 1"). Never a provision/LP id.

quotes.description: Verbatim quoted passages bearing on this target. Empty array if none found.
